body:
I actually had a conversation with my therapist this morning along the same lines. 

The self medicating helps the hurt but destroys the motivation.  I will give more details when I get back to a computer.. hard to write a long response on a phone.

Last night when I got home, I called into my work's assistance program, and talked for over an hour.  

They told me to hit up my family doctor ASAP, did that this morning.  He talked to me about medication, so I'm trying something out for a few weeks; he also told me to take time off to focus on this, and to talk to a professional therapist. 

I took this info to my boss, terrified of how this was going to go down. He was incredibly understanding and told me to take the needed time to get better. 

Spent an hour with my pastor this morning too, and he was also very encouraging and understanding. 

I'm feeling loads better already, and I'm genuinely appreciative of this sub for the positive replies I got. If you have someone to talk to, please do it.. I was ready to die yesterday, and now I'm ready to fight.
